_source: Shared inner-page sidebar (About Us / Quick Links / Address), copied verbatim from the baseline (git tag baseline-static-site), which renders this identical block on every inner page built from src/_layouts/page.njk. Phone numbers are stored as the bare tel: digit-string (with leading +); sidebar.njk derives the human-readable "+965 ..." display text from it.
about: AIIS is where your child can discover what they love and grow into who they want to be. We focus on academic progress alongside emotional, social and creative growth, building a school where every student is encouraged to reach their full potential.
